periods.name: 远山家伍绝·绝钉
periods.description: A technique turning Kinji's body and fingertip into a rigid nail-like point via 'Zetsu'. He strikes the exact center of Carbuncle's jewel hammer, exploiting crystal cleavage to shatter the Nine-Jeweled Vajra.
